No actions this turn. I've already read the booking app, and the next step is checking I've understood the request.

---

Here's what I've understood: members who book a lane get a text at 18:00 the evening before. The point is fewer no-shows, so lanes don't sit empty while people on the waiting list miss out. Members who ticked "no texts, please" never get a text from the club.

What I found in the booking app:

- **The club already texts.** The newsletter goes out through your SMS provider, so reminders can use the same account. Nothing sends reminders yet.
- **A sizeable group would get no reminder at all.** 23% of members have "no texts" ticked. Email is blank for 61% of members, so many of that 23% can't be reached any other way either. Those members are just as likely to forget a booking.

Correct anything I've got wrong.

The open question that would change what gets built most is what happens with "no texts" members:

- **A. Nothing.** This is the simplest option and matches the spec exactly. Roughly a quarter of bookings would get no reminder.
- **B. Email them if they have an address.** This reaches some of that group and respects their choice of no texts. It means building an email reminder alongside the text.
- **C. Treat a reminder as something they asked for, not a "club text."** I'd advise against this. It goes against what they ticked on the form.

I'd pick **B**. Which way would you go?

Or if you'd rather I just dive in and build the spec as written, say so.
